sources.version: Companion manuscript dated 3 November 2026; original 19-page revision
sources.bibliographic_metadata_check: Confirmed the title, contributor, version, date, page count and version-specific link on the Hexagon record. The existing local paper copy and its recorded reading scope are retained; this metadata check is not a new proof review.
sources.role: Motivation and comparison; the augmented-span estimate in the earlier proof supports the stated counting consequence. Not an input to the proof of the present main theorem.
sources.actual_read_scope: Main theorem, Proposition 2.1, and Section 7 reread on 4 November 2026. Checked the augmented-span bound before (7.1), the parameter estimates (7.3)-(7.4), and the passage from multiples of 34 to all sufficiently large even endpoints. The irrationality-count deduction is explained in Appendix B of the current paper. No new audit of the earlier full proof or imported propositions is claimed.
sources.counting_consequence_check: The criterion gives the augmented span dimension at least 1-log(alpha)/log(B). At multiples of 34 the ratio of -log(alpha)/log(B) to sqrt(s/log(s)) tends to c_star=0.2174562348...>0.21. Monotonicity and bounded endpoint gaps give augmented dimension at least 1+0.21 sqrt(s/log(s)) for all sufficiently large even s. Rational entries lie in Q*1, so the augmented dimension is at most I(s)+1. The deduction is included in Appendix B of the new paper; no additional counting statement has been added to the cited manuscript.
